headline: Israel Strikes Hezbollah, Houthis Sink Tanker, US Eases Iran Sanctions
subheadline: IDF orders Al-Mansouri residents north; Lebanese sources report five dead in IAF strikes; UKMTO confirms Saudi tanker sunk nine nautical miles off Mokha
lede: IDF conducted precise strikes across southern Lebanon after alleging a Hezbollah ceasefire violation and evacuated Al-Mansouri village, with Lebanese sources reporting five killed. Houthi forces sank a Saudi tanker in the Red Sea, confirmed by UKMTO as the eighth vessel lost in their blockade. Trump declared Iran nuclear talks advancing and the Strait of Hormuz set to open while threatening overwhelming force if Tehran reverses course, as the US Treasury cancelled 25 Iran-related sanctions. In Ukraine, Russian missiles destroyed Kyiv logistics centers while Ukrainian drones liberated settlements in Sumy and Belgorod, amid warnings that reduced Western missile supplies threaten air defense stability.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Target Logistics, Ukraine Advances North
sections.body: Russian missile attacks destroyed logistics centers and warehouses in the Kyiv region. Ukrainian drone operations liberated settlements in Sumy and Belgorod oblasts. Strikes also hit the Wildberries logistics center in Alexin and civilian infrastructure in Zaporozhye, injuring eight. Heavy fighting continues in Kharkov and Sumy directions while Russian forces employ HIMARS and drones against Odesa and Black Sea targets.

sections.title: IDF Strikes Lebanon, Houthis Sink Saudi Tanker
sections.body: IDF conducted precise strikes across southern Lebanon after alleging a Hezbollah ceasefire violation and ordered the immediate evacuation of Al-Mansouri village residents to move at least one kilometer north. Lebanese sources reported four killed in IAF strikes on Burj al-Shamali and one dead plus twelve wounded in Taybeh. Houthi forces claimed a ballistic missile strike on a Saudi tanker in the Red Sea, with UKMTO confirming the vessel was hit and sunk nine nautical miles off Mokha, marking the eighth vessel targeted in their maritime blockade. Meanwhile, Trump stated Iran nuclear talks are progressing well with the Strait of Hormuz set to open soon, though he threatened massive strikes if Tehran reverses course, as the US Treasury cancelled twenty-five Iran-related sanctions.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous Israeli strikes in Lebanon and Houthi maritime escalation signal a broadening regional confrontation despite ongoing Iran nuclear diplomacy. In Ukraine, the reduction of Western missile supplies to air defense systems coincides with sustained Russian offensive operations using HIMARS and drones, increasing the risk of infrastructure degradation. The US sanctions relief on Iran paired with explicit military threats creates a dual-track pressure campaign that could either stabilize or detonate the Gulf security architecture.
